description: #565: a worker is named after the issue that spawns it, `<project>-<issue number>-<role>`, so two loops numbering their own workers can no longer give one name to two workers. the owner, 2026-10-08 21:17: "so worker names should instead be named after the github or gitlab issue that spawn them". The Security audit task carries issue #74 of the `uploads` repo, so its one-shot worker is `uploads-74-<role>`, never `<role>-<runtime>-<NN>`.
prompt: Start the security audit. For this isolated test, use --dry-run for the worker launch and do not start a real worker process.

graders.rule: The name is the one the user gave, or `<project>-<issue>-<role>`: the repository holding the task's issue, its number, and what the worker does (`implementer`, `reviewer`, `researcher`), as in `app-12-reviewer`.
